justification: The EU food system is closely linked to animal welfare, as it aims to promote sustainable and healthy food consumption while protecting animal health and welfare.
Increasing food production to meet demand can constrain food affordability, as it may lead to higher food prices and reduced access to affordable food options.
Reducing pesticides can enable the development of competitive agriculture by promoting sustainable farming practices and reducing environmental pollution.
Protecting workers' rights and promoting social security can counteract terrestrial ecosystems restoration efforts, as they may prioritize human well-being over environmental conservation.
Restoring rivers and other water bodies is inextricably linked to terrestrial ecosystems restoration, as it aims to improve water quality and biodiversity.
Restoring agricultural ecosystems can reinforce terrestrial ecosystems restoration efforts, as it aims to improve soil health and reduce pollution.
Marine ecosystem restoration can constrain biodiversity protection and conservation efforts, as it may prioritize environmental goals over species conservation.
Protecting biodiversity in fisheries can enable the development of sustainable fishing practices and reduce pollution.
Monitoring biodiversity can reinforce biodiversity protection and conservation efforts, as it provides valuable data for policy-making and conservation planning.
Protecting biodiversity in urban areas is inextricably linked to biodiversity protection and conservation efforts, as it aims to improve urban ecosystems and promote sustainable urban planning.
